title: What you really get for free: ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini (Oct 2026)

scenes.text: Which free AI gives you the most? We checked the official pages.
scenes.say: Which free A I gives you the most? We checked the official pages.

scenes.text: ChatGPT's free plan runs GPT-6 Luna. Claude gives you Sonnet and Haiku. Gemini gives you Flash-Lite, with Auto mode stepping up for hard prompts. Its flagship, Argon, is paid only.
scenes.say: Chat G P T's free plan runs G P T six Luna. Claude gives you Sonnet and Haiku. Gemini gives you Flash Lite, with Auto mode stepping up for hard prompts. Its flagship, Argon, is paid only.

scenes.text: The big difference is limits. ChatGPT now offers unlimited text chats, though files, images and voice stay capped. Claude and Gemini both reset every five hours, and Gemini adds a weekly cap.
